# BMaGlass Pay

> BMaGlass Pay is a Bitcoin wallet and payments platform for everyone in the world. Its main product is a Bitcoin wallet — available as a custodial wallet or a self-custody wallet where the user holds their own seed phrase — with supporting payments features built around it. Website: https://bmaglasspay.online

## What BMaGlass Pay is

- BMaGlass Pay is a global Bitcoin wallet and payments platform. It is for everyone, everywhere — not only for users in Zambia.
- The Bitcoin wallet is the main product. Users can hold, send and receive Bitcoin on-chain and over the Lightning Network, in a custodial wallet or in their own self-custody wallet.
- BMaGlass Pay was founded by Mabvuto Banda and is headquartered in Lusaka, Zambia. Zambia is its home base and its first market for local fiat payment rails; the service itself is worldwide.

## Who it is for

- Individuals anywhere in the world who want a Bitcoin wallet to hold, send and receive Bitcoin.
- People who prefer self-custody: the self-custody wallet keeps the seed phrase with the user.
- Merchants and businesses that want to accept Bitcoin payments, including merchants in Zambia collecting local mobile money payments.

## Key features

- Bitcoin wallet (main product): custodial and self-custody options, on-chain and Lightning Network sending and receiving, QR-code payments.
- P2P marketplace: a peer-to-peer marketplace for buying and selling Bitcoin (Bitcoin only).
- Bitcoin payment links: share a link to request or receive a payment.
- Bitcoin POS: point-of-sale acceptance of Bitcoin for in-person merchants.
- PayPal: send and receive payments via PayPal through the platform.
- Mobile money collections: merchants in Zambia can collect mobile money payments (via Lenco).
- Virtual cards: coming soon.
- Developer tools: an API, SDKs and ready-made connectors (including WooCommerce, Odoo and Magento) for accepting payments in other products and stores.
